## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #219 at **e2142dc70556cd0a649f3c5f0ec7ee5b4c24f801**. Exact-head delta verification only, not a new round: `31bf8fb74039744fcdb4b28cb392ed9393184ff5..e2142dc`, two OMP TypeScript files, +72/-1. **P219-F002 is resolved.**

After child creation, the follow-up task send now receives the same `opts.signal` as spawn (`.omp/extensions/pij/adapters/rust-runtime.ts:715-727`). Caller/body construction is unchanged. The signal reaches the existing refusal-retry loop, which checks abortion after its restart wait and before another send (`adapters/daemon-http.ts:460-520`).

The regression first creates the child, then refuses the task send; its injected wait aborts the spawn and restores daemon availability. It asserts rejection, exactly one send attempt and zero task writes (`adapters/rust-runtime.spawn.test.ts:445-494`). This checks the post-wait effect, not merely the presence of a forwarded signal.

**Retained limit:** an already-created child remains; cancellation does not roll back creation. Earlier accepted contract/rendering/timing qualifications carry forward. No other production semantics changed in this delta.
